text:
Mutations are errors in DNA that change the nucleotide sequence, arising from replication mistakes, DNA damage, or mutagen exposure. Their effects range from harmful to neutral to beneficial, and germline mutations can be passed to offspring while somatic mutations affect only the individual who carries them. The team note's claim that every mutation disrupts protein function and lowers fitness is incorrect, because many mutations are silent, neutral, or advantageous.

CONFIDENCE: 90
